About the Practice

The University of Arizona is a public land-grant research university in Tucson, Arizona, classified as an R1 institution with very high research activity. [16] The university integrates basic and translational science with advanced preventive and specialty care through its affiliation with Banner – University Medical Centers in Tucson and Phoenix, offering care in areas such as geriatrics, nephrology, urology, cardiology, oncology, trauma, and neuroscience. [2, 16] The Division of Dermatology provides specialized clinical services for skin, hair, and nails, including treatment for skin diseases and tumors. [10] Additionally, Campus Health offers comprehensive medical, mental health, and wellness services to the university community. [9, 13]
